description: Start a VoIP quality analysis of an uploaded .pcap/.pcapng capture (upload it with kind "pcap"). Reconstructs SIP calls and RTP streams and scores every stream (Sevana MOS from the decoded speech, network MOS, loss, jitter). Returns a job_id; the call waits up to wait_seconds and, if the analysis finished by then, includes the summary. Otherwise poll job_status. Only analysis reports are returned, never decoded audio. Reports include SIP messages and DTMF digits as captured; they are kept for one hour.

statistics.description: compute aggregate statistics across streams (default true)

wait_seconds.description: wait up to this many seconds for the result (0-55, default 25)

name: pcap_analyze

expires_at.description: the result is deleted at this time

queue_position.description: approximate place in the queue while queued

stage.description: current stage while running: parsing, audio, sip, ...

summary.description: set when a PCAP job is done

health.description: analyzer warnings: one-way audio, codec/ptime asymmetry, late media, ...; empty = healthy

worst_mos.description: lowest Sevana MOS of the call's streams

omitted.description: calls/streams left out of the lists; see pcap_full_report

impairments.description: PVQA detector -> number of 0.68 s intervals where it fired

mos_network.description: MOS estimated from loss and jitter only

mos_sevana.description: listening-quality MOS from the decoded speech (1-5); 0 or null = not scored (e.g. SRTP without key)

title: PCAP: analyze a capture
